name: webscraper-etl
description: Plataforma ETL semi-automatizada para extracción visual de datos en e-commerce

scripts.build:backend: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.prisma:generate: pnpm --filter backend prisma generate --config prisma.operational.config.ts && pnpm --filter backend prisma generate --config prisma.analytics.config.ts
scripts.prisma:push: pnpm --filter backend prisma db push --config prisma.operational.config.ts && pnpm --filter backend prisma db push --config prisma.analytics.config.ts
scripts.prisma:migrate: pnpm --filter backend prisma migrate dev --config prisma.operational.config.ts && pnpm --filter backend prisma db push --config prisma.analytics.config.ts
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: pnpm --filter backend prisma migrate deploy --config prisma.operational.config.ts && pnpm --filter backend prisma db push --config prisma.analytics.config.ts
